title: Update from template v0.4.43
body:
copier update to v0.4.43, carrying ESC-79 (additive --gate-branch), ESC-80 (the arming job verifies the base is gated before arming and fails closed), ESC-78 (a branch sweep at every driver stop), plus ESC-74 to ESC-77.

Run from the lane base rather than the default branch, because this repository default branch carries no scaffold and so no .copier-answers.yml for copier update to read. Nothing hand-written rides along; template-sync verifies that.

Opened by the delivery driver on base run/web.
